changed_30d.display_name: Apodex launches the Apodex 1.1 agentic model family

excerpt.description: Apodex - Apodex, a new startup led by Chen Tianqiao with chief scientist Simon Du, released Apodex 1.1 — a proprietary general agentic flagship built for verifiable long-horizon professional and scientific work via a web workbench and an asynchronous "Agent Team" — alongside the open-weight Apodex 1.1 mini (35B, Apache 2.0, rolling out), the FrontierAgent harness, and an arXiv report. Parameter count for the flagship is undisclosed.
excerpt.title: Apodex launches the Apodex 1.1 agentic model family

changed_30d.display_name: Apodex 1.1 mini released as an open-weight 35B model

excerpt.description: Apodex - The 35B open-weight member of the Apodex 1.1 release, designed to run locally under the open-source FrontierAgent harness as a ReAct or multi-agent Agent Team. Announced under Apache 2.0 with weights and developer docs still rolling out at launch.
excerpt.title: Apodex 1.1 mini released as an open-weight 35B model

excerpt.description: DeepSeek - DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal (text + image -> text) checkpoint live on the DeepSeek API. It extends the 284B-total / 13B-active V4-Flash MoE with image understanding (up to 600 images per request) over a 1M-token context, matching V4-Flash on text while making a major leap on multimodal agent benchmarks, priced at $0.22/$0.66 per Mtok. Weights were not published at launch.
excerpt.title: DeepSeek launches the experimental DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp

excerpt.description: Tencent Hunyuan - Tencent Hunyuan open-weighted Hy-MT2-30B-A3B, a fast-thinking multilingual machine-translation MoE (30B total / ~3B active) covering 33 language pairs plus Chinese-dialect and minority-language pairs, with an 8K context small enough to run locally.
excerpt.title: Tencent open-weights Hy-MT2-30B-A3B

changed_30d.display_name: Ornith-1.5-9B released with an on-device Mobile build

excerpt.description: DeepReinforce (Ornith) - The smallest Ornith-1.5 model, a 9B dense coding/agent model, released under MIT with weights on Hugging Face and a quantized Ornith-1.5-9B-Mobile build for iPhone and Android. Vendor-reported: 47.0 Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 70.6 SWE-Bench Verified.
excerpt.title: Ornith-1.5-9B released with an on-device Mobile build

excerpt.description: DeepReinforce (Ornith) - The mid-size Ornith-1.5 model, a 35B MoE activating ~3B parameters per token, released under MIT with weights on Hugging Face. Vendor-reported: 68.5 Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 79.0 SWE-Bench Verified, which DeepReinforce reports as beating dense models of similar or larger size.
excerpt.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B released

changed_30d.display_name: DeepReinforce releases the open-weight Ornith-1.5 family

excerpt.description: DeepReinforce (Ornith) - DeepReinforce released Ornith-1.5 in three MIT-licensed scales — a 397B MoE flagship, a 35B MoE (3B active), and a 9B dense model with a mobile build — with weights on Hugging Face. The family extends Ornith-1.0's self-scaffolding into a closed self-improvement loop: the model proposes its own progressively harder tasks, generates an orchestration scaffold for each, and produces the RL rollouts. Vendor-reported (five-run-avg): the 397B scores 85.1 Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 56.0 DeepSWE, which Ornith puts on par with Claude Opus 4.8 (85.0 / 59.0).
excerpt.title: DeepReinforce releases the open-weight Ornith-1.5 family

changed_30d.display_name: Alibaba ships open weights for Qwen3.8-27B

excerpt.description: Alibaba (Qwen) - Alibaba published Qwen3.8-27B on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0 — the single-GPU open sibling of Qwen3.8-Max. A 27B dense, hybrid-attention model with a native 262K context (extendable to 1M via YaRN) and multimodal (text/image/video) input, promoting the earlier announced-only entry to generally available.
excerpt.title: Alibaba ships open weights for Qwen3.8-27B

excerpt.description: Dots Studio (rednote-hilab) - Dots Studio (rednote-hilab), the AI lab of Xiaohongshu (RedNote), released Dots3-Note Preview, a ~280B / ~16B-active MoE with a 512K context and text+vision+audio input, under Apache-2.0. Introduces TEMPO, an RL method for long-horizon agents that checkpoint their own progress.
excerpt.title: Dots Studio open-weights Dots3-Note Preview

excerpt.description: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) - Z.ai released GLM-5.3, a 743B coding model reusing the GLM-5.2 base with expanded post-training, keeping the 1M-token context and 128K output. Launched via the GLM Coding Plan and ZCode; open weights held back pending a safety review (~2 weeks out).
excerpt.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3

changed_30d.display_name: Alibaba ships open weights for Qwen3.8-Max

excerpt.description: Alibaba (Qwen) - Alibaba published the open weights of its Qwen3.8-Max flagship on Hugging Face and ModelScope as Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B under Apache 2.0 — the same 2.4T-total / ~95B-active MoE, now downloadable with a 262K context extendable to 1M via YaRN, alongside the smaller Qwen3.8-27B.
excerpt.title: Alibaba ships open weights for Qwen3.8-Max

excerpt.description: Google DeepMind - Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash, a fast, low-cost workhorse tuned for coding and agents: 1M-token context, 65K output, multimodal input, and $0.75/$3.75 per Mtok introductory pricing through 2026-12-31. Reported DeepSWE v1.1 jumped to 65.3% from 49.0% on Gemini 3.6 Flash.
excerpt.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3.7 Flash

excerpt.description: xAI - xAI released Grok 4.6, a post-training update on the reported 1.5T-parameter V9 foundation behind Grok 4.5, with a 500K context, configurable reasoning effort, and $2/$6 per Mtok list pricing below 200K tokens.
excerpt.title: xAI releases Grok 4.6

changed_30d.display_name: Cohere publishes North Micro Vision Instruct

excerpt.description: Cohere - Cohere released North Micro Vision Instruct, a 2.4B Apache-2.0 document-focused vision-language model with a native-resolution vision encoder and a Command A+ language backbone. Strong on document tasks (0.921 DocVQA, 0.808 ChartQA) and grounding (0.732 RefCOCO), with open weights on Hugging Face.
excerpt.title: Cohere publishes North Micro Vision Instruct

excerpt.description: Liquid AI - Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3.1B open-weight edge vision-language model on the LFM2.5-2.6B base with a SigLIP2 400M vision encoder, tuned for on-device screen understanding, grounding, and tool calling. Reported 80.7 on ScreenSpot-v2 and 69.4 averaged across 28 benchmarks; runs at ~228 tok/s on an Apple M5 Max.
excerpt.title: Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-VL-3B

excerpt.description: NVIDIA - NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a hybrid Mamba-2 + MoE + Attention model (~31.6B total / ~3.6B active) with a 1M-token context, under OpenMDW-1.1 with weights, data, and recipes — shipped alongside the NeMo Switchyard router.
excerpt.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning

changed_30d.display_name: Sakana AI opens Namazu as an API

excerpt.description: Sakana AI - Sakana AI released Namazu, a Japanese-specialized reasoning/agent model built on Moonshot's open-weight Kimi K2.6, over a 262K context with native web-search and code-execution tools, priced at $0.95/$4.00 per Mtok. Not available in the EU/EEA, UK, or Switzerland.
excerpt.title: Sakana AI opens Namazu as an API

changed_30d.display_name: Microsoft releases MAI-Code-1.1-Flash in GitHub Copilot

excerpt.description: Microsoft - Microsoft released MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, an efficiency-focused agentic coding model rolling out across GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code). Microsoft reports +22% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and +15% on .NET over MAI-Code-1.0, with 25% greater token efficiency at roughly a quarter of the cost.
excerpt.title: Microsoft releases MAI-Code-1.1-Flash in GitHub Copilot

excerpt.description: Upstage - Upstage released Solar Pro 4, an agent-first reasoning workhorse with a 524K-token context and up to 131K output tokens, priced at $0.30/$1.20 per Mtok (launch promo $0.03/$0.12). Upstage is the first Korean company registered as an official model provider.
excerpt.title: Upstage unveils Solar Pro 4

excerpt.description: OpenAI - OpenAI launched GPT-5.6-Cyber, a cybersecurity-specialized model built on GPT-5.6-Sol with a lower refusal rate on dual-use security tasks, reporting a 95% completion rate on advanced exploit-chain prompts. Access is gated to vetted defenders through the new Daybreak Red tier; the model is not generally available and weights are not released.
excerpt.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber

changed_30d.display_name: Meta releases the open-weight Muse Glimmer

excerpt.description: Meta AI - Meta released Muse Glimmer, a ~30B dense agentic model with a ~1.8B vision encoder, under Apache 2.0 — its first open-weight model after the closed Muse Spark line. Multimodal (text + image input, text output) across 100+ languages, 131K context, and tuned to run on a single consumer GPU or a Mac.
excerpt.title: Meta releases the open-weight Muse Glimmer

excerpt.description: Ant Group (inclusionAI) - Ant Group inclusionAI open-weighted Ling-3.0-tiny under MIT — a sparse MoE with 7.9B total / ~1.3B active parameters and a 262K context, distinct from the API-only Ling-3.0-flash. Weights ship in BF16, FP8, and INT4.
excerpt.title: Ant Group open-weights Ling-3.0-tiny

excerpt.description: Liquid AI - Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, a 2.69B dense on-device model on a hybrid conv + GQA stack with a 131K context, built to plan and call tools entirely on-device. Open weights under the LFM Open License, shipped day-one in GGUF, MLX, and ONNX.
excerpt.title: Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-2.6B

changed_30d.display_name: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.2 and Muse Code

excerpt.description: Meta AI - Meta shipped Muse Spark 1.2, a flagship coding model with 1M-token context and multimodal input, priced at $1.25/$4.25 per Mtok (plus a 12x-cheaper contributor tier), alongside Muse Code, a terminal-based coding agent powered by the model.
excerpt.title: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.2 and Muse Code

excerpt.description: Alibaba (Qwen) - Alongside Qwen3.8-Max GA, Alibaba announced a smaller open-weight Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint with a firm open-weights timeline — its first for the 3.8 generation.
excerpt.title: Alibaba announces open-weight Qwen3.8-27B

changed_30d.display_name: Alibaba ships Qwen3.8-Max to general availability

excerpt.description: Alibaba (Qwen) - Qwen3.8-Max went GA on 2026-08-03, two weeks after its WAIC preview: a 2.4T-parameter MoE (~95B active) with 1M-token context, multimodal input, and firm pricing of $2/$6 per Mtok. Alibaba committed to open weights for Qwen3.8-Max and a smaller Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint.
excerpt.title: Alibaba ships Qwen3.8-Max to general availability

changed_30d.display_name: V4-Flash API upgraded to the 0731 build

excerpt.description: DeepSeek - The deepseek-v4-flash API endpoint is silently upgraded to the retrained DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 production build. Same endpoint, key, and model name; pricing unchanged at $0.14/$0.28 per Mtok.
excerpt.title: V4-Flash API upgraded to the 0731 build

excerpt.description: DeepSeek - DeepSeek ships DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, the production build of V4-Flash: the April preview retrained on an improved post-training pipeline for coding, agents, reasoning, and tool use, with the architecture untouched (284B total / 13B active MoE, 1M context). DeepSeek reports it beating its own larger V4-Pro-Preview on all nine published agent and coding benchmarks. Weights on Hugging Face under MIT; API pricing held at $0.14/$0.28 per Mtok, and the swap is silent for existing deepseek-v4-flash callers.
excerpt.title: DeepSeek promotes V4-Flash-0731 to production
